summary: Write a poem you can use rimes or rhymes any number of times no matter the on set that gets you started just share the journey students need to see you as a writer in their community of authors #ILAchat #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Write a poem
you can use rimes
or rhymes
any number of times
no matter the on
set that gets you started
just share the journey
students need to see you as a writer
in their community of authors #ILAchat
#smallpoems
